turns.question: Which channel got us leads most cheaply in September 2026, and what did each lead cost?
turns.answer: In September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30) email was the cheapest channel at 37.50 EUR per lead (8 leads on 300.00 EUR of ad spend), followed by search at 42.07 EUR per lead (92 leads) and social at 52.50 EUR per lead (40 leads). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: And which channel's leads were the most expensive, at what price?
turns.answer: Social was the most expensive channel, at 52.50 EUR per lead over September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
